hero.heading: About ICS
hero.lead: ICS is an industrial engineering company specializing in the design, construction, installation, and maintenance of cooling tower systems for industrial applications.
hero.body: We are committed to delivering reliable solutions that improve system performance, operational stability, and long-term efficiency for industrial facilities.

presence.heading: Global Presence
presence.lead: ICS combines cooling tower expertise from its main office in Lakewood, Colorado, with offices in Japan and Bangkok, Thailand.
presence.body: We are committed to serving all stakeholders, including customers, employees, suppliers, and communities.

offices.title: Lakewood, Colorado
offices.subheading: Industrial Cooling Solutions in the USA
offices.lead: ICS’s main office is located in Lakewood, Colorado.
offices.body: Our USA operations provide full lifecycle services, including new construction, repair, upgrades, and spare parts supply for cooling towers from many manufacturers, supporting reliable performance and long-term operational efficiency.

offices.title: Bangkok, Thailand
offices.lead: ICS has an office in Bangkok, Thailand.
offices.body: ICS provides project engineering, procurement, field support, and technical assistance for cooling tower systems.

offices.title: Japan
offices.lead: ICS has an office in Japan.
offices.body: ICS supports new cooling tower installations, repair and upgrade projects, and spare parts supply.

team.heading: Expert Engineering Team
team.lead: Our team of cooling tower specialists brings together deep expertise in engineering, design, manufacturing, and field execution.
team.turnkey: We deliver complete turnkey cooling tower systems and cooling tower islands, covering everything from new installations to repairs, upgrades, and spare parts from manufacturers including Amarillo, Brentwood, Hudson, and Howden.
team.clients: Our experience includes working with global industrial leaders such as Shell, Star Energy, Shintech, Shin-Etsu, TTCL, PTT Group, Pertamina, Mitsubishi, and Marubeni.

services.heading: What We Do
services.lead: ICS provides complete cooling tower lifecycle services, including:
items: Spare parts supply and system optimization
services.closing: Each service is designed to support continuous industrial operation and long-term system reliability.

commitment.lead: ICS is committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions built for durability and efficiency.
commitment.body: We focus on corrosion-resistant design, energy-efficient operation, and reduced maintenance requirements to support long-term system stability.
commitment.band: Our goal is to improve operational performance while minimizing lifecycle costs for industrial clients.
